declarations.name: AuiCheckboxGroup
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI CheckboxGroup: `<aui-checkbox-group>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Legend text and accessible name of the group.

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the legend; it remains the accessible name.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name shared by every checkbox.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Group help text referenced by the fieldset's aria-describedby.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: At least one option must be selected.

inputs.name: minSelected
inputs.description: Minimum selections once any option is selected (integer 1..options.length).

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the selection invalid.

inputs.name: validationTiming
inputs.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error; cleared when the selection changes.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial selection and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

accessibility.pattern: Native <fieldset> + <legend> grouping native checkboxes, each with a <label for> (HTML; WAI-ARIA APG Checkbox).

limitations: minSelected and maxSelected apply once anything is selected; an empty optional group is valid (HTML constraint semantics). Use `required` to demand a selection.
Selection-count messages have singular and plural forms only; languages with more plural categories need a custom validate message.
Group-level help text and errors are referenced from the fieldset; some screen readers announce fieldset descriptions only when entering the group.
